paite: Pathian aw, na gouluah ding ah namte alut ua; na tempul siangthou ahihnin uhi; kisesa in Jerusalem akoih uhi.
heading: Asaph phatna La / Nam Hotkhiakna Dia Thumna
english: A Psalm by Asaph. God, the nations have come into your inheritance. They have defiled your holy temple. They have laid Jerusalem in heaps.

paite: Na sikhate luang tungleng vasate an ding in apia ua, na misiangthoute sa gamsate kiang ah apia ua.
english: They have given the dead bodies of your servants to be food for the birds of the sky, the flesh of your saints to the animals of the earth.

paite: Asisan uh Jerusalem kim ah tui bang in asungbua ua; amau vui ding lah kuamah a-om ngal kei uhi.
english: They have shed their blood like water around Jerusalem. There was no one to bury them.

paite: I kim ua mite gensiat in i na om ua, i kiangnai a mite muhsit leh nuihsan in i na omta uhi.
english: We have become a reproach to our neighbors, a scoffing and derision to those who are around us.

paite: TOUPA aw, bang tan ahia na heh nilouh ding? Na mullitna mei bang in akuang ding ahia?
english: How long, Yahweh? Will you be angry forever? Will your jealousy burn like fire?

paite: Nangmah thei lou namte tung a na hehna sungbua in, na min sam lou gam tung ah.
english: Pour out your wrath on the nations that don’t know you, on the kingdoms that don’t call on your name,

paite: Jakobte ane khin ua; a-omna uh ahihgamta uhi.
english: for they have devoured Jacob, and destroyed his homeland.

paite: Ka pipute uh thulimlouhnate ka lak uah theigige ke'n; na lainatna in hon don pah hen. Nakpitak a hihniam in ka omta ngal ua.
english: Don’t hold the iniquities of our forefathers against us. Let your tender mercies speedily meet us, for we are in desperate need.

paite: Hon hondampa Pathian aw, na min thupina ding in hon panpih inla; na min ziak in hon humbit in, ka khelhnate uh silsiang in.
english: Help us, God of our salvation, for the glory of your name. Deliver us, and forgive our sins, for your name’s sake.

paite: Bang achia namte'n, a Pathian uh koi a omta ahia le, chi ding uh ahia? Na sikhate sisan pawt phulakna ka mitmuh un namte lak ah theih hi hen.
english: Why should the nations say, “Where is their God?” Let it be known among the nations, before our eyes, that vengeance for your servants’ blood is being poured out.

paite: Henta thumna na ma ah tung hen; na thilhihtheihna thupidan bang zel in si ding a sehte humbit in.
english: Let the sighing of the prisoner come before you. According to the greatness of your power, preserve those who are sentenced to death.

paite: TOUPA aw, nang ahon gensiatna uh, ka kiangnai uate tung ah aleh sagih in thuk in.
english: Pay back to our neighbors seven times into their bosom their reproach with which they have reproached you, Lord.

paite: Huchi in kou na mite, na gantatna mun a belamte'n, tangtawn in kipahthu ka hon hilh ding uhi; suan tengteng tan in nangmah phatna ka theisak zel ding uhi.
english: So we, your people and sheep of your pasture, will give you thanks forever. We will praise you forever, to all generations.
